prompt:
Ultra-realistic, high-end fashion editorial studio portrait of a beautiful young Korean woman standing confidently in a luxury photography studio. The scene uses an intentionally minimal lighting setup with a nearly black seamless backdrop, allowing the subject to become the sole focus. A single large softbox positioned slightly to one side creates soft sculpting light across her face, while a subtle rim light gently separates her silhouette from the dark background. No props, no distractions, and no environmental elements.

She poses with effortless confidence, maintaining elegant posture and direct eye contact with the camera. She wears a modern, sophisticated fashion-forward outfit consisting of a tailored black cropped blazer layered over a sleek ivory satin camisole, high-waisted wide-leg charcoal trousers, a slim leather belt with a subtle metallic buckle, delicate silver jewelry, and pointed black heels. Her long glossy dark hair falls naturally with a clean center part, complementing natural Korean-inspired makeup featuring flawless luminous skin, soft neutral eyeshadow, defined lashes, subtle eyeliner, and muted rose lips.

The composition is clean, premium, and editorial, emphasizing her facial features, outfit, and confident presence. Rich shadows, cinematic contrast, refined skin texture, realistic fabric details, and luxury magazine aesthetics. Captured on a full-frame professional camera with an 85mm portrait lens at f/1.8, shallow depth of field, razor-sharp focus on the eyes, ultra-high resolution, true-to-life colors, Vogue-quality fashion photography, masterpiece, photorealistic, premium commercial studio shoot. Vertical 9:16 composition.

promptZh:
一张超写实、高端时尚杂志风的摄影棚肖像，主角为一位 美丽的年轻韩裔女性，正自信地站在豪华摄影棚内。场景采用刻意极简的布光设置，背景为近乎全黑的无缝幕布，使主体成为唯一焦点。一盏大型柔光箱置于侧前方，在她的面部投射出柔和的塑形光，同时一束微妙的轮廓光将她的身形与深色背景轻轻分离。画面中无道具、无干扰元素，亦无环境背景。

她姿态从容自信，保持着优雅的体态并与镜头进行直接的眼神交流。她身着 一套现代、精致且前卫的时尚装束，包括一件剪裁利落的黑色短款西装外套，内搭丝滑的象牙白缎面吊带，下配高腰阔腿炭灰色长裤，系着一条带有精致金属扣的细皮带，佩戴简约的银饰，脚踩黑色尖头高跟鞋。她那头乌黑亮丽的长发自然垂落，中分发型显得干练利落。妆容采用韩式自然风格，展现出无瑕透亮的肌肤、柔和的中性色眼影、根根分明的睫毛、精致的眼线以及豆沙玫瑰色的唇妆。

构图简洁、高级且具有杂志质感，突显了她的面部特征、服饰搭配以及自信的气场。画面呈现出丰富的阴影、电影级的对比度、细腻的皮肤纹理、逼真的面料细节以及奢华的杂志美学。使用全画幅专业相机搭配 85mm 人像镜头 在 f/1.8 光圈下拍摄，浅景深效果，焦点精准锐利地落在双眼上，超高分辨率，色彩真实自然，Vogue 级时尚摄影，大师之作，照片级真实，高端商业摄影棚拍摄。9:16 竖构图。
